import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MM_N = 33;
    static final int mo = 1000000007;
    
    static int mm_n;
    
    static class Mat {
        long[][] a = new long[MM_N][MM_N];
        
        void plus() {
            for (int i = 0; i < mm_n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < mm_n; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = (a[i][j] % mo + mo) % mo;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static Mat one = new Mat();
    
    static Mat multiply(Mat a, Mat b) {
        long[][] ans = new long[MM_N][MM_N];
        for (int i = 0; i < MM_N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MM_N; j++) {
                ans[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        
        long infa = 8000000000000000000L;
        for (int k = 0; k < mm_n; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < mm_n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < mm_n; j++) {
                    ans[i][j] += a.a[i][k] * b.a[k][j];
                    if (ans[i][j] >= infa) {
                        ans[i][j] %= mo;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        Mat c = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i < mm_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mm_n; j++) {
                c.a[i][j] = ans[i][j] % mo;
            }
        }
        return c;
    }
    
    static Mat qpow(Mat a, long b) {
        a.plus();
        Mat n = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i < MM_N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MM_N; j++) {
                n.a[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                n = multiply(n, a);
            }
            a = multiply(a, a);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return n;
    }
    
    static void mm_init(int sz) {
        mm_n = sz;
        for (int i = 0; i < mm_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mm_n; j++) {
                one.a[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static long[] readLongArray(int n) {
        long[] arr = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = readLong();
        }
        return arr;
    }
    
    static long readLong() {
        int c;
        try {
            c = System.in.read();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return 0;
        }
        
        int sg = 1;
        while ((c < '0' || c > '9') && c != '-') {
            try {
                c = System.in.read();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
                return 0;
            }
        }
        
        if (c == '-') {
            sg = -1;
            try {
                c = System.in.read();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
                return 0;
            }
        }
        
        long x = c - '0';
        while (true) {
            try {
                c = System.in.read();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
                break;
            }
            
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                break;
            }
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        
        return x * sg;
    }
    
    static int[] nu = new int[111];
    static int tot;
    static Mat[] a = new Mat[100];
    
    static Mat jia(Mat x, int d) {
        Mat ret = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i < mm_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mm_n; j++) {
                ret.a[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < mm_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mm_n; j++) {
                int ni = (i != mm_n - 1) ? (i + d) % (mm_n - 1) : mm_n - 1;
                int nj = (j != mm_n - 1) ? (j + d) % (mm_n - 1) : mm_n - 1;
                ret.a[ni][nj] = x.a[i][j];
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        long n = readLong();
        int k = (int) readLong();
        mm_init(k + 1);
        
        tot = 0;
        while (n > 0) {
            nu[tot++] = (int) (n % k);
            n /= k;
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j < k + 1; j++) {
            a[0] = new Mat();
            a[0].a[0][j] = 1;
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j < k + 1; j++) {

            a[0].a[j][j] = 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i < tot; i++) {

        int ad = 0;
        Mat ans = new Mat();
        for (int p = 0; p < MM_N; p++) {

            for (int j = 0; j < nu[i]; j++) {
                ans = multiply(ans, jia(a[i], (j + ad) % k));
            }
            ad = (ad + nu[i]) % k;
        }
        
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < k + 1; i++) {
            ret = (int) ((ret + ans.a[i][k]) % mo);
        }
        System.out.println(ret);
    }
}
